videos.name: mercy_100_parts_en
videos.title: 100 Parts of Mercy
videos.title_en: Allah Kept 99 Parts of His Mercy for You
videos.caption: Allah sent down only ONE part of His mercy… and kept 99 for His servants on the Day of Resurrection 🤍 Comment “Ya Rahman” 🤲

lines.text: Allah divided His mercy into {100 parts}.
lines.say: *Allah* divided His mercy | into one hundred parts.

lines.text: He sent down just {one} to the earth.
lines.say: He sent down | just *one* | to the earth.

lines.label: The one part
lines.text: Because of it, creatures are merciful to each other…
lines.say: Because of it, | creatures are merciful | to each other,

lines.label: The one part
lines.text: {even} a mare lifts her hoof so she won’t hurt her foal.
lines.say: *even* a mare | lifts her hoof | so she won't hurt her foal.

lines.label: For you
lines.text: for His servants, on the {Day of Resurrection}.
lines.say: for His servants, | on the Day of *Resurrection*.

lines.text: If {one} part is all the mercy in this world…
lines.say: If *one* part | is all the mercy in this world,

lines.label: Allah says
lines.sub: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.” (Az-Zumar 39:53)
lines.say: Do not despair | of the mercy of *Allah*.

lines.text: Comment “{Ya Rahman}” if you need His mercy today.
lines.say: If you need His mercy today, | comment: | Ya Rahman.

sources.wording: faithful rendering of the linked English translation
